introHtml: Salutepromos lanyards offer a reliable, cost-effective solution for bulk orders of custom lanyards and badge holders. With options like the durable 1" Knit-In Lanyard or the eco-friendly 3/4" Recycled Lanyard, you can choose materials that match your event or corporate identity. These lanyards are ideal for trade shows, employee IDs, and school events, providing a professional way to display credentials. Decorate with full-color imprinting for maximum brand visibility.
